title: GTA VI
subtitle: Leonida checklist
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made checklist. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.
news: Big 100% update: robbery, race, hidden-find, reading and vehicle totals plus three more trophies.

categories.name: Explore Leonida
categories.note: The six regions Rockstar has shown, plus named spots in Vice City.

items.name: Reach Vice City
items.detail: The neon, beach-and-nightlife heart of Leonida.

items.name: Island-hop the Leonida Keys
items.detail: Bridges, bars and turquoise water south of the city.

items.name: Head into the Grassrivers
items.detail: Swampy wetlands with mangroves and gators.

items.name: Visit Port Gellhorn
items.detail: A run-down old vacation coast with cheap motels.

items.name: Roll through Ambrosia
items.detail: Leonida's industrial and farming country.

items.name: Explore Mount Kalaga National Park
items.detail: Wild parkland up on the northern border.

items.name: Explore all of Leonida
items.detail: Uncover the whole map. This one counts toward a trophy.

items.name: Walk Ocean Beach
items.detail: Vice City's beachfront strip.

items.name: Eat your way through Little Cuba
items.detail: One of Vice City's named neighborhoods.

items.name: Browse the Tisha-Wocka flea market
items.detail: A named Vice City market.

items.name: Check out the Vice City port
items.detail: The busy commercial waterfront.

items.name: Spot a sea turtle
items.detail: Keep an eye on the water around the Keys.

items.name: Spot an alligator
items.detail: The Grassrivers are full of them. Keep your distance.

categories.note: Five chapters, about 93 story missions in total (early count from launch-week guides). Spoiler-free: chapters only, no mission names.

items.detail: Side stories from the odd characters you meet around Leonida.

categories.name: Collectibles
categories.note: Totals from launch-week guides: 18 card sets (480 cards), 397 stunts, 80 challenges, 125 flamingos, 33 underwater finds, 34 reads. Where 100% needs fewer than all, both goals are listed. Counts get corrected if guides change them.

items.detail: Counts toward a trophy.

categories.name: Trophies & achievements
categories.note: 55 trophies in total, including the Platinum. Written in our own words. Story, collectible and vehicle trophies live in their own sections above. Newest entries come from early guides and may be adjusted.

items.name: Gold medal on all 42 Shooting Range challenges
Win a drone race at all 14 locations
Win a fishing challenge against a local
Hunt a unique animal for a hunting contact
Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach
Max out Strength for both partners
items.detail: Train at gyms; after the story you can train at home too.

items.name: Shake a 4-star wanted level together with your partner
Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing the heat
Rob a jewelry store without being spotted
Rob 5 bank vaults and get away
Rob an armored truck and get away
Hit an illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs
Drop 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus
Take a tank from the military air base and fight from inside it
Do 500 things that shape your criminal profile
Knock down 10 pedestrians on a bike within 60 seconds
Catch something strange in the night sky
items.detail: Late at night, alone, out in the countryside. May take a few tries.

items.name: Rob the same payday loan store a second time and escape on foot
items.detail: Opens up later in the story.

items.name: Unlock the Platinum
items.detail: PlayStation only. On Xbox, unlock every achievement.
